name: angular-electron-telemetry-monitor
description: Angular + Electron Windows desktop telemetry monitoring application

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 http://localhost:3000/api/health && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start:prod: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .
